violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrived during the inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink was observed with hot water turned off. When hot water is turned on, a disconnected pipe to the dish machine sprays water into the kitchen and onto cabinets.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. A follow up visit will be conducted to ensure that the handwashing sink is equipped with hot water.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. Observed a can of RAID in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. RAID discarded by building engineer.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: Apples and oranges observed contaminated by spray from exposed plumbing line from dish machine. Water sprays when hot water is turned on at handsink.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. Fruit to be discarded.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connection to the DISH MACHINE is observed disconnected, water continuously sprays when hot water is turned on.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EHS will conduct a follow up to ensure that water is properly capped or connected.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present. Management stated the establishment has recently had turnover in staff.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EHS will follow up with establishment on 11/10/25 to ensure a CFM is present.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the QUATERNARY AMMONIUM solution was measured at 500+ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food- contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of QUATERNARY AMMONIUM solution at 150-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. -EHS instructed PIC to dilute sanitizer solution with water to create proper concentration. -Please contact chemical company to recalibrate the premix system.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Chlorine sanitizer strips observed in establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit by 11/10/15.

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. Please obtain irreversible temperature device by 11/10/25.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the DISH MACHINE piping are leaking, creating a puddle on the floor and damage to the wall next to machine.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

violations.observation: Observed that the WALL NEXT TO THE DISH MACHINE is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.
